pipeline.modality: Oral peptide tablet (N-Tab platform) containing PTH(1-34)
pipeline.license_origin: Entera proprietary (N-Tab platform); patent rights from Oramed

indications.trial_design: Phase 3 in postmenopausal women with osteoporosis; primary endpoint = change in total hip BMD; key secondary endpoint = incidence of new/worsening vertebral fractures at 24 months. Protocol/SAP submitted to FDA Feb 2026.
indications.trial_status: PLANNED - Phase 3 initiation targeted 2H 2026 subject to additional financing; Phase 2 (NCT04003467) completed and met primary/secondary endpoints
key_milestones: FDA Type A meeting agreement July 2025 supports single P3 study for NDA
FDA December 2025 Determination qualifies total hip BMD as surrogate endpoint
Going concern qualification - financing required to start P3

excluded_preclinical: EB612 (oral PTH(1-34) / LA-PTH for hypoparathyroidism) - preclinical; IND filing targeted late 2026; collaboration expanded with OPKO Feb 2026
EB618 / Oral OXM (oral GLP-1/Glucagon dual agonist for obesity, metabolic, fibrotic disorders) - preclinical; OPKO planning Phase 1 SAD/MAD with SC formulation by end 2026, then IND for oral tablet
Oral GLP-2 (short bowel syndrome) - preclinical proof-of-concept in rodents
excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT03516773 EB612 oral PTH(1-34) Phase 2 hypoparathyroidism - COMPLETED 2018
NCT04003467 EB613 EBP05 Phase 2 postmenopausal low bone mass - COMPLETED 2021 (will support P3)
NCT02152228 oral PTH(1-34) Phase 2 hypoparathyroidism pilot - COMPLETED 2015
excluded_partner_owned: OPKO-led Phase 1 SAD/MAD of subcutaneous OXM (precursor to oral OXM) - partner-led, not Entera asset
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: All Entera-sponsored clinical trials are completed; lead asset EB613 awaiting Phase 3 initiation (planned 2H 2026, financing-dependent). Other programs (EB612, EB618, oral GLP-2) are preclinical. Listed EB613 as Phase 3-PLANNED per workflow rule 5.
